```python
568 :     def test_subclassed_boolean_reductions(self, all_boolean_reductions):

Conclusion: The test `pandas.tests.frame.test_subclass.TestDataFrameSubclassing.test_subclassed_boolean_reductions` checks whether boolean reductions (`all`, `any`, `sum`) return instances of `SubclassedSeries`. However, the test failed because these methods are not returning instances of `SubclassedSeries`, but rather instances of the standard `pandas.Series`.

Upon examining the code snippet for `__getitem__` method in pandas.core.frame.DataFrame, we find that there is no special handling for boolean reductions to return `SubclassedSeries`. Instead, it uses the regular `_getitem_bool_array` function which returns a `pandas.Series`. This mismatch between expectations and implementation leads to the AssertionError.

Methods to be fixed:
```
pandas.core.frame.DataFrame.all
pandas.core.frame.DataFrame.any
pandas.core.frame.DataFrame.sum
```
